hook: One American account has a triple tax break.

blocks.narration: One American account has a triple tax break. Most people walk right past it every year during open enrollment season.
blocks.visual: A paper-cutout first-aid kit shaped like a piggy bank sits on cream paper, slow push-in

blocks.narration: It is called a health savings account, or H S A. You can open one if you are on an eligible high-deductible health plan.
blocks.visual: A paper door with a medical cross swings open, revealing a small glowing piggy bank inside

blocks.narration: Break number one: money goes in before taxes, through payroll or as a deduction, so you pay less tax this year.
blocks.visual: Paper coins slide into the piggy bank slot as a green check mark stamps beside it

blocks.narration: Break number two: the money can be invested and grow without being taxed along the way, year after year.
blocks.visual: A small green paper sprout grows out of a pile of coins inside the bank, a second check mark stamps

blocks.narration: Break number three: withdrawals for qualified medical expenses come out tax-free. Think doctor visits, prescriptions, and even many dental bills.
blocks.visual: Coins flow out of the bank into a paper pharmacy bag, a third check mark stamps

blocks.narration: For twenty twenty-seven, the limit is forty-five hundred dollars for individual coverage and nine thousand dollars for family coverage.
blocks.visual: Two paper envelopes of different sizes slide in side by side, the family one twice as large

blocks.narration: Unlike a flexible spending account, unused money is not lost at year end. It stays yours, even if you change jobs.
blocks.visual: A paper calendar flips to January while the coins stay safely inside the bank

blocks.narration: If a high-deductible plan fits your health needs, this account is worth a serious look. Save this for open enrollment.
blocks.visual: Coins stack into a tall tower while green and cream paper confetti falls

captions.hook_line: Open enrollment tip: the account with a triple tax break 💚
captions.body: With an HSA-eligible high-deductible health plan, contributions can go in pre-tax, grow tax-free and come out tax-free for qualified medical expenses. 2027 limits: $4,500 self-only, $9,000 family.

youtube_title: The HSA: The Only Triple Tax Break Most People Skip
